title: OpenAI just open-sourced GPT-4 and nobody is talking about it

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenAI just open-sourced GPT-4 — and no one’s talking about it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could change how AI is built and used globally.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They released the full code and training data for GPT-4.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It includes advanced reasoning and multilingual support.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers, researchers, and companies are all impacted.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is a huge shift in AI accessibility and innovation.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What will you build with open-source GPT-4?
